text: 道指开盘涨0.04%，纳指涨0.13%，标普500涨0.11%。明星科技股英伟达涨0.91%，微软涨0.79%，英特尔跌3.35%。纳斯达克中国金龙指数涨0.71%，阿里巴巴涨1.51%，蔚来涨1.48%。
text_en: The Dow opened up 0.04%, the Nasdaq rose 0.13%, and the S&P 500 rose 0.11%. Among prominent technology stocks, Nvidia rose 0.91%, Microsoft rose 0.79%, and Intel fell 3.35%. The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index rose 0.71%, Alibaba rose 1.51%, and Nio rose 1.48%.
